summary_markdown: A participant provided an update regarding a US conference, noting positive discussions with major Out-of-Home (OOH) companies. Concrete dialogues were established to conduct Proofs of Concept (POCs) with Lamar (focusing on Baton Rouge roadside screens), Clear (targeting 1-2 airports and potential transit areas), and Outfront. Additional talks occurred with Pattison Outdoor from Canada and Siroky Canada.
